title: Fill the Bubble Sort
story: Bubble sort swaps neighbours that are in the wrong order until everything is sorted.
goal: Print the list sorted from smallest to largest.
hints: Swap when the left neighbour is bigger than the right one.
socratic: When are two neighbours in the wrong order?
What happens if you use < instead?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did the blank teach you in “Fill the Bubble Sort”?
